name: Fracture Nonunion
definition: Failure of a fracture to achieve progressive union within an expected timeframe, commonly due to inadequate biology, stability, infection or a combination.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and often CT assess union; infection and metabolic evaluation are essential when indicated.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Identify mechanical, biological and infection causes
amber: Definitive treatment may require revision fixation, debridement, bone grafting and infection control.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna sandhana concepts may support rehabilitation but cannot replace mechanical/infectious correction.

patientEducation.summary: Failure of a fracture to achieve progressive union within an expected timeframe, commonly due to inadequate biology, stability, infection or a combination.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
